en: Black‑and‑white street view showing a broad avenue lined with multi‑story buildings and trees. In the foreground on the right is a shop with a large sign reading "Gustav Raatz, Glaserei." A few adults and children stand on the sidewalk. Farther down the street stand more shops and residential buildings; one corner building has an onion‑shaped dome. In the distance a tall church spire dominates the skyline. At the top of the image appears the caption "Senftenberg-L. — Bahnhofstraße." The overall look suggests an early 20th‑century European town scene.
